listing.name: Known Skies 1.1.0
listing.summary: A mod that adds a "special" new unique star in the sector which gives buffs to all planets in its system. It will randomly replace a procgen star like the unique planets from Unknown Skies. Also adds a command for ConsoleCommands which allows you to convert any star into that special star.

description:
A mod that adds a "special" new unique star in the sector which gives buffs to all planets in its system. It will randomly replace a procgen star like the unique planets from Unknown Skies. Also adds a command for ConsoleCommands which allows you to convert any star into that special star.

In the special star system music may not play for **LONG** periods of time, **THIS IS INTENTIONAL**. When the game is paused music will resume however (this is also intentional).

Save compatible but the star will require a new save to spawn (you can just use the console),
https://github.com/JamesTripleQ/Known-Skies/releases/latest

~~This was hell~~
